headline: Your website is healthy and fully cared for.
summary: In August we added live error monitoring, fixed the footer contact button and cleaned up the codebase. Every change is live and verified.
improvementsNote: Four changes shipped this month, each one tied to an area of ongoing care.

improvements.title: Live error monitoring switched on
improvements.body: The site had none before. Errors are now captured automatically.

improvements.title: Footer contact button fixed
improvements.body: It now looks and works like a clear, clickable action.

improvements.title: Codebase cleaned up
improvements.body: We reviewed the full history and tidied outdated, unused work.

improvements.title: Every fix deployed and verified
improvements.body: All fixes are now live on the site and verified in production.
